criterion: At least 6 of 9 modules reproduce the prespecified direction.
Progenitor–radial-glia and synaptic-assembly modules both pass.
Donor-level BH-adjusted P < 0.05 and direction retained in at least 80% of leave-one-out reconstructions.
Observed effects exceed the 95th percentile of module-size- and expression-matched random gene-set effects.
At least 3 frozen TF candidates receive replicated enhancer-driven multiome support.
At least 2 TFs show reciprocal knockout/overexpression effects and agreement across two perturbation methods.
At least one final TF or its regulon has concordant public CRISPR/Perturb-seq support.
